audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Skill at Levels 3 and 4-5 and Galio at Level 6, while every whys[] row said Yone-favoured and the packet levelChart is Yone for all seven rows at a 51.29% win rate over 3182 games.
audit.why: Galio brings no sustained lane DPS; his only trade opener is Justice Punch (E) on 11s at rank 1, and Hero's Entrance is a 180s global peel tool, not a solo-lane duel button.
audit.corrected: Yone favoured on all seven rows; the lane is decided by whether you respect the E-into-W taunt window, not by a power flip at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 row credited Galio with a lane spike; his ultimate is on 180/160/140s and lands as a peel/roam tool.
audit.why: Yone's own spikes are Mortal Steel at 2 stacks, Soul Unbound dropping 22s to 10s across ranks, and the first crit item. Galio's spikes are Justice Punch rank-ups (11s to 7s) and MR items.
audit.corrected: Spikes: your Q3 knockup and Soul Unbound cooldown reduction, first item; his are Justice Punch rank-ups and a 180-second R he saves for the map.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text called Fate Sealed a source of 'team knockups nothing can dodge', and attributed Galio's taunt to his Q.
audit.why: Fate Sealed blinks behind the LAST champion in a line and pulls everyone hit toward Yone — no knockup. Galio's taunt is Shield of Durand (W), a charged stance; Justice Punch (E) is the dash-knockup that sets it up. Winds of War (Q) is a damage-over-time tornado only.
audit.corrected: Fate Sealed pulls, it does not knock up — angle it so pulled enemies land in your team. Galio's kill pattern is E knockup into the W taunt; the Q only ticks damage. His Q is a projectile pair, and Shield of Durand cuts magic damage far harder than physical, which matters because your passive is magic and your crits are not.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers on the tracked ability.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7 seconds; Shield of Durand is 18/17/16/15/14.
audit.corrected: Punish inside the 11-second Justice Punch window at rank 1; it shrinks to 7s by rank 5, so early is when the window is worth the most.

audit.whatIsWrong: Colossal Smash auto-reset tell not mentioned.
audit.why: Galio's combo opens with an empowered auto that resets his attack — the wind-up, not the ability cast, is the cue.
audit.corrected: Recorded in edits via the ability-interaction lines.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Galio's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in the line and pulls — never line up with your team. Hero's Entrance is a 180s peel tool, not a duel button.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Galio carry threat: 6/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls the enemies it clips toward you — angle it so they land inside your team. Galio carry threat: 6/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — Q3 + E burst, snap back safe.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) is his dash-knockup, 11s at rank 1 and 7s at rank 5; it sets up the Shield of Durand taunt. Spent it? Q3 + E burst, snap back.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A dash-knockup that feeds his W taunt, 11s at rank 1 and 7s at rank 5. Step up only once it is spent.

edits.before: E-ing in while his answer is up or overstaying the soul timer — the snap-back position is where Yones die.
edits.after: Mortal Steel's second stack is your dash-knockup — dumped into the wave, you have no engage when he steps up.

edits.before: Galio R Hero's Entrance is a global peel tool, not a lane duel button, so on a solo island you commit freely; just track if he's saving it to roam-assist a gank.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is a 180-second global peel tool, not a lane duel button, so on a solo island you commit freely; track it, since he saves it to swing a gank elsewhere.

edits.before: Your crit spike out-damages his MR-tank build hard in an isolated 1v1 since he brings almost no personal DPS to lane.
edits.after: Your crit spike beats his tank build 1v1 — Shield of Durand cuts magic damage far harder than physical, and your crits are physical.

edits.before: Land Justice Punch (E) into Q for a taunt-and-slow combo
edits.after: Land Justice Punch (E) into the Shield of Durand taunt

notes: Chart rows 3, 4-5 and 6 were flipped to Yone in both layers as a matched atomic group; the packet levelChart, the 51.29% win rate over 3182 games and all seven whys[] rows already said Yone, so the Skill/Galio rows were the outliers. Two ability errors fixed: Fate Sealed described as a knockup (it is a blink-behind plus pull) and Galio's taunt credited to his Q (it is Shield of Durand, W). Exact Shield of Durand percentages were left out of the prose since only the mirror note carries them and it is truncated there — the relative statement (magic cut far harder than physical) is safe.
